script.title: SCHOOL REGISTRATION
script.scene_zh: 學校註冊處 · 幫孩子報名
script.story_hook: A mom registers her son but one form is missing.
script.intro_zh: 媽媽幫兒子報名入學，卻發現少了一份文件。
script.welcome_en: Welcome back, dear listeners! Today we're registering a kid for school.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎回來，親愛的聽眾！今天我們要幫孩子辦理學校註冊。
script.outro: Registration done, one small file to go. You learned a lot today.
script.outro_zh: 註冊完成，只差一份文件啦。你今天學到很多。
script.practice_intro_en: Now it's time to listen and repeat.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在是聆聽跟讀的時間。
script.char_a_description: a friendly mother in her late thirties with a chestnut bob cut, wearing a soft lavender cardigan over a white tee and small gold earrings, clutching a folder of papers and a pen
script.char_b_description: a calm registrar man in his fifties with thinning silver hair and rectangular glasses, wearing a beige vest over a striped shirt, stamping forms behind a tidy desk
script.youtube_title: 【🏫學校註冊實用英文】「只要表格送來就行」？📋報名缺文件別慌，聽完就會問｜🎧A2 聽力練習｜School Registration
script.youtube_title_en: “As Long As the Form Arrives” — Registering a Kid for School
script.youtube_description:
幫孩子在國外學校報名，最怕聽到一堆文件名稱？這一集帶你走進學校註冊處，跟著一位媽媽練習住址證明、舊校紀錄與預防接種表的問法，缺件也能從容補件。整段 18 句美式日常英語，附上繁體中文翻譯與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，聽一遍就敢開口用。
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱我們的頻道，每天一集，讓英語變成你的直覺！
script.youtube_description_en:
Worried about school registration words like proof of address or immunization form? This episode walks you into a real registrar's office, where a mom hands over papers, learns one form is missing, and fixes it calmly. 18 lines of everyday American English with IPA, plus a listen-and-repeat section so the phrases stick.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🏫學校註冊英文｜住址證明・舊校紀錄・補發文件｜聽完就會辦報名｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
孩子要進國外學校，註冊清單看不懂的恐懼你有嗎？
住址證明、接種紀錄，缺一樣該怎麼辦？

這一集帶大家走進學校註冊處，跟著一位媽媽從報年級、繳交證明文件，到發現少了一份預防接種表之後補件，全程都用自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
📄 報名基本問答：例如「Is this for grade three?」、「I'm here to register my son.」。
🏠 證明文件：例如「Do you have proof of address with you?」、「here's our latest water bill.」。
💉 缺件補件：例如「That one's required before his first day.」、「we accept emailed copies」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

家長們別慌，報名其實可以這麼清楚！
script.thumbnail_action: handing a paper folder across the desk
script.title_quote: As long as the form arrives

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good morning! I'm here to register my son.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈmɔrnɪŋ aɪm hɪr tə ˈrɛdʒəstər maɪ sʌn/
dialogue.zh: 早安！我來幫我兒子辦理註冊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Welcome! Is this for grade three?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, Leo. He starts after the break.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈlioʊ hi stɑrts ˈæftər ðə breɪk/
dialogue.zh: 對，Leo。假期結束後就要開學。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great. Do you have proof of address with you?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt du ju hæv pruf əv əˈdrɛs wɪð ju/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sure, here's our latest water bill.
dialogue.zh: 當然，這是我們最新的水費單。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect. And his records from the old school?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt ənd hɪz ˈrɛkərdz frʌm ði oʊld skul/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。那他在舊校的紀錄呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, I have the report card but...
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm aɪ hæv ðə rɪˈpɑrd kɑrd bʌt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, the immunization form, I think.
dialogue.zh: 我想是預防接種記錄表。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That one's required before his first day.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌnz rɪˈkwaɪərd bɪˈfɔr hɪz fɜrst deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那份表在第一天上學前一定要交。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My clinic can email it. Would that work?
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈklɪnɪk kæn ˈimeɪl ɪt wʊd ðæt wɜrk/
dialogue.zh: 我們的診所可以用 email 送信，這樣可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we accept emailed copies no problem.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wi əkˈsɛpt ˈimeɪld ˈkɑpiz noʊ ˈprɑbləm/
dialogue.zh: 可以，我們收 email 傳來的電子副本，沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll ask them today. When should I check back?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl æsk ðəm təˈdeɪ wɛn ʃʊd aɪ tʃɛk bæk/
dialogue.zh: 我今天就跟診所說。我什麼時候該再確認？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: By Friday, and I'll finish the paperwork.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ˈfraɪdeɪ ænd aɪl ˈfɪnɪʃ ðə ˈpeɪpərwɜrk/
dialogue.zh: 星期五之前傳到，我就幫你把手續完成。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So he can still start on Monday?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ hi kæn stɪl stɑrt ɑn ˈmʌndeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 也就是說他星期一照舊能開學？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yep, as long as the form arrives.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛp əz lɔŋ æz ðə fɔrm əˈraɪvz/
dialogue.zh: 是的，只要那份表格送來就行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What a relief. Thank you for your help.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ə rɪˈlif θæŋk ju fɔr jɔr hɛlp/
dialogue.zh: 真是鬆了一口氣。謝謝你的幫忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anytime! Here's a map for Monday morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛniˌtaɪm hɪrz ə mæp fɔr ˈmʌndeɪ ˈmɔrnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣！這是星期一早上用的校園地圖。
